data.research_question: Can the selected Trump Foundation headquarters target be advanced with defensible public location evidence, and has materially new Greater Israel/Foundation news appeared since the prior successful pass?
data.method: Refreshed current main at b79ae106b2b541a7ffaf3ff03f27715569e655a5 and re-read the live v0.9.0 schema/Auto-Dig/Free-Range/write/merge contract. Enumerated 27 physical dig roots; excluded free-range as the meta-root, leaving 26 research dataset/topic roots. Applied the previous-three successful hourly anti-repeat rule to cia, larry-fink, and graphika, leaving 23 dataset-stage candidates. Run seed 8688300586870198991 is the first 64 bits of SHA-256('2026-08-18T18:55:01-04:00|b79ae106b2b541a7ffaf3ff03f27715569e655a5'); uniform sampling over the sorted diversity-eligible roots selected greater-israel. The latest Greater Israel pass exposed two open queued targets after terminal exclusions; target seed 8884427178326928125 from SHA-256(run-seed|greater-israel|target-stage-v1) selected starintel:investigation-target:greater-israel-trump-foundation-explicit-hq-street-designation. HQ phase refreshed LinkedIn, which continues to distinguish headquarters locality (Modi'in) from a primary street location (2 HaMaayan St., Atrium Building), and reviewed a State of Israel service page that identifies the official Modi'in-Maccabim-Re'ut municipality name. The pass therefore refines the headquarters locality to the municipality while preserving the street-level HQ question as unresolved and adding no coordinates. Registry/gov.il/GuideStar-focused searches did not surface a current authoritative source explicitly designating 2 HaMaayan St. as headquarters. Current-news searches for the foundation in English and Hebrew after the prior same-topic pass returned no material new post-cutoff development; no filler event was created. The GitHub connector can enumerate normalized target files and packet search results, but this runtime cannot execute the repository-wide Free-Range DB+packet discovered-candidate loader because direct GitHub DNS is unavailable; the complete actionable frontier count is therefore recorded as search-limited rather than fabricated.

findings.finding: LinkedIn continues to label Modi'in, Israel as the foundation's headquarters and 2 HaMaayan St., Atrium Building as its primary location.
State of Israel material supports Modi'in-Maccabim-Re'ut as the canonical municipality name for the locality.
No reviewed authoritative registry or first-party legal/governance source explicitly designates 2 HaMaayan St. as the foundation's headquarters street.
No materially new post-prior-pass Foundation/Greater Israel news item was found in the bounded English/Hebrew current-news scan.
